facts.value: RGBA 256x256; alpha 142-172; flat pixels (128,128,255) fit a normal map (inference). Encoding and alpha undocumented.

facts.claim: Four formats live; S3 freshness; CORS for browser use
facts.value: Sizes confirmed. Last-Modified 2017-11-11, 2017-11-11, 2017-12-01, 2016-04-22. ACAO * on GET with Origin for all four, skadi included; HEAD gets no ACAO (CORS allows GET only).

facts.claim: Airport: NWS vs DEM; the brief's 'about 1,090 m'
facts.value: NWS KBIL 1111.91 m. DEM at station point 1085.09-1091.99 m (20-27 m below). FAA field 3,662 ft = 1,116 m (Wikipedia; AWC elev 1116, unit unstated): DEM 24-31 m below. Brief figure matches DEM at station only; origin unverified.

facts.claim: Billings city-centre sources; GNIS not reached
facts.value: MSL 3153: no unit in header; '125 feet' note suggests feet (961 m if feet). Wikipedia 3,212 ft (979 m) footnoted to GNIS; body 3,126 ft (953 m). GNIS 2409849 unreachable. NWS grid cell BYZ 103,92 = 975.06 m. DEM 951.9-952.0 m.

facts.claim: Registry names no provider; credits in joerd; 3DEP public domain
facts.value: Registry: Mapzen only; 'bare-earth terrain heights'. joerd: 3DEP public domain 'without restriction'; attribution 'required for many terrain tile data providers'. USGS FAQ: 'free and in the public domain' (3DEP not named).

facts.claim: CesiumTerrainProvider formats; custom heights need a callback
facts.value: 'Quantized Mesh' and 'Height Map' only; no Terrarium, Terrain-RGB, PNG, GeoTIFF. Custom heights: JS callback, row-major; no water mask, normals or availability.
Community 'Personal and non-commercial use'. Paid account for 'more than $50K in annual gross revenues', or a government project; 'Exploratory commercial or government development' allowed free.
